mechanism: Systemic absorption of ophthalmic prednisolone is minimal; amiodarone is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor but prednisolone ophthalmic has negligible systemic exposure, limiting clinically significant interaction.
action: No dose adjustment required; monitor for any unexpected systemic corticosteroid effects if prednisolone ophthalmic is used frequently or if patient develops signs of corticosteroid excess.
